check_route_access: check if a route is allowed by a list of allowed route patterns including exact, wildcard, and placeholder matches
is_llm_api_route: check if a route is an LLM API route for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, or other provider endpoints
is_virtual_key_allowed_to_call_route: check if a virtual API key is permitted to call a specific route based on allowed_routes configuration
non_proxy_admin_allowed_routes_check: check if a non-proxy-admin user is allowed to access a given route by role and permissions
check_passthrough_route_access: check if a route is allowed via passthrough routes defined in user or team metadata
_route_matches_pattern: check if a route matches a pattern with placeholders like /threads/{thread_id}
_route_matches_wildcard_pattern: check if a route matches a wildcard pattern like /scim/v2/*
should_call_route: check if a route should be called by validating enterprise checks and virtual key permissions
_check_proxy_admin_viewer_access: check if a proxy admin viewer role is allowed read-only access to management routes
custom_admin_only_route_check: check if a route is restricted to admins only and enforce enterprise premium requirement
